primitive: JurnlProductNav portals into the viewport-level .jrn-nav-host (JurnlRuntimeRoot → JurnlNavHostContext). It is no longer a child of any column, so no family, content width or screen can move it.

geometry.grid: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)) — five equal cells; + is cell 3 = the geometric centre
geometry.labels: nowrap, clipped to the cell — label width can never move an icon

reserve: Content ends above var(--jrn-nav-reserve); the nav never overlays content.

measured_before.note: F05–F16 hubs docked the nav to the content column; F03/F04 were centred.

safe_area.rule: bottom and reserve both include env(safe-area-inset-bottom)
safe_area.note: SITE00 index.html has no viewport-fit=cover, so iOS Safari reports 0 and keeps the page above the home indicator itself; with cover (standalone/PWA) the rule applies as proven by the CDP emulation.
